summary: Use generative AI for finance analysis, modelling, and reporting with practical data controls. Explore the course and build a safe workflow plan.
lede: Generative AI for finance helps finance, accounting, FP&A, audit and treasury professionals support analysis and reporting while checking outputs against source records. The course covers prompt design and verification, Excel model review, variance analysis in Excel and Power BI, and AI-assisted audit-sampling decisions. Participants also practise privacy and output-quality checks, including data minimization, source reconciliation, and review of generated narratives before use.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for finance professionals who handle sensitive data, explain financial movements, support assurance work, or approve reporting workflows that may use generative AI. This course is designed for: CFOs setting controls for LLM use in financial reporting and planning. Finance Managers reviewing AI-assisted close, budgeting, and management-reporting workflows. FP&A Analysts validating AI-generated forecasts and variance explanations against source data. Management Accountants checking model assumptions and drafting performance commentary. Internal Auditors assessing AI-assisted audit sampling and evidence traceability. Treasury Professionals reviewing AI-drafted cash-flow and liquidity analysis. Financial Controllers maintaining reconciliations and approval controls for AI-assisted outputs. Finance Systems Analysts mapping LLM workflows to Excel and Power BI data. Public Sector Finance Officers checking narrative reports against approved financial records. Financial Planning Managers prioritizing safe automation opportunities across finance teams.
modules: NIST AI Risk Management for Finance
prerequisites: Working knowledge of finance, accounting, FP&A, audit, or treasury workflows and basic Excel use is expected. No programming is required. Bring a laptop; access to an organization-approved LLM is useful for practical exercises, subject to your organization’s data policies.
